head: # Vibecode audit — $name
Generated by /vibecode-audit on $date. Axes: $axes. $coverage audit.
headless_notice: > **Default order.** No interaction was possible: the attack order and the fate of the minor patterns are the skill's defaults, with no arbitration by the user.
dead_notice: > **Family not audited: $unit.** Its auditor returned no usable JSON block after a relaunch: it is listed among the unauditable surfaces.
limits: > **Scope and limits of this audit.** Read-only static diagnosis, produced by a language
> model. It does not replace an application security review: no access to the runtime
> environment, to credentials, to the real configuration of third-party services or to traffic; no
> penetration test. The auditor shares some of the blind spots of the model that produced the code —
> the absence of a finding on a family proves nothing. The surfaces listed below could not be
> **Validation.** $validated patterns out of $total passed the adversarial validation. The others are
> marked `not validated`: they were not refuted, they were not verified.
> **Difficulties are orders of magnitude, not estimates.** They vary from one audit to
> another on the same code. Severity, on the other hand, is stable: the order rests on it.
